text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Our nanny is hard at work, I hear. I<n>imagine it's
because our family is<n>coming together after so long
to<n>celebrate your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that right? I wish she<n>wouldn't—it's nothing to
get so<n>excited about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, can you blame her? Our parents<n>and other
relatives are taking time out<n>of their busy schedules
to be there,<n>so she wants to make it special.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's just try to enjoy this time with<n>our precious
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Personally, I'm looking forward to<n>simply being
able to speak with you.<n>Perhaps we can reminisce
about old<n>times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm your sister. Would it be anything<n>else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
All right. I suppose I should finally go<n>and show my
face at home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That would be nice. Mother and<n>Father are very
much looking forward<n>to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of special events... will you<n>be preparing
any of the food there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you needn't worry. Nanny will<n>be personally
making all your<n>favorites.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really? I'd like to have some of<n>your cooking
once in a while. It's<n>light, like a dusting of snow...
